name: Rehearsal A (vibration + fatigue): eVTOL motor-mount arm, invented card, not an official task
source: invented 2026-11-02 for docs/11 area A; data from research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/A_titresim_yorulma.md

loads._note: peak motor thrust (invented); ultimate = 1.5 x 1.15 x limit

limits._note: f1 >= 1.5 x blade-pass frequency (Burela & Sujit, arXiv:2607.22768, 2026 preprint, sec. V.C [D]); blade pass = 2 blades x 3000 rpm / 60 = 100 Hz (invented rotor)

fatigue._note: hover thrust 400 N with a +-30 % once-per-rev fluctuation (invented); 1e7 cycles = 28 h at 100 Hz, so the 1e7 strengths below are a screening value, not an endurance claim

AlSi10Mg.source: as-built surface 50-75 MPa at 1e7, R=-1 (Afroz et al. 2022 Int J Fract Table 5 [S]); midpoint 60; Ftu_Pa holds Fty (Ftu not read), i.e. Soderberg, conservative

Scalmalloy.source: as-built surface sigma_a 41 MPa at R=0.1, ~1e7 (Musekamp et al. 2021 Metals 11:1961 Fig. 8 [D]) -> fully reversed 41/(1 - 50.1/490) = 46 MPa (Goodman with Fty) [H]; Ftu_Pa holds Fty

Ti-6Al-4V.source: L-PBF, HIP, as-built surface, R=-1 (Greitemeier via Afroz 2022 Table 3 [S]); annealed as-built 200; Ftu_Pa holds Fty

7075-T6.source: bar, R=-1, MIL-HDBK-5J best-fit S-N equation solved at 1e7 (A_titresim_yorulma.md table 1d [D]/[Y]); machined surfaces; Ftu_Pa holds Fty
